title: Container build exhausts the Java heap
root_cause: The image build runs Atlas with a 32 MB heap, while the program retains roughly 100 MB of arrays. The JVM exhausts its heap and the nonzero exit causes the Docker build to fail.

relevant_evidence.why: The JVM reports a heap exhaustion within the build step.
The build limits the JVM heap.
The program retains the allocated arrays.
